layout.heading: What Is an **SMM Panel API?**
layout.body:
An [SMM panel](/) API (Application Programming Interface) is a technical bridge between your system and SMMGen's backend. Instead of logging into the dashboard to place each order manually, your system sends an automated request to SMMGen's server. The server processes the order and returns a response with the order ID and status.

Everything that happens inside the SMMGen dashboard can happen through the API. Placing orders, checking status, cancelling eligible orders, retrieving your account balance, and pulling the full service catalog with live pricing — all available programmatically.

This is the tool that makes an [SMM reseller](/smm-reseller-panel) business scalable. Manual ordering has a ceiling. The API removes it.

cards.title: Resellers With Their Own Panel Website
cards.body:
If you operate a reseller website where clients place orders directly, the SMMGen API handles fulfillment automatically. When a client orders on your site, your system forwards the request to SMMGen via API. Delivery starts. Status updates return to your dashboard in real time. You never touch the order manually.

This is the technical foundation of the [white label SMM](/white-label-smm-panel) panel model.

cards.body: Agencies using automation tools, internal dashboards, or project management systems can connect those tools to SMMGen via API. cards.title: Developers Building Custom Tools
cards.body: Developers building custom SMM ordering interfaces, Telegram bots, Discord bots, or browser extensions use the SMMGen API to power service delivery. Any application that needs to place social media orders programmatically can connect through the API.

cards.title: Wholesale Buyers Ordering at Volume

cards.title: Getting Your SMMGen API Key
cards.body:
Your API key is available inside your SMMGen dashboard.

Create a free account at [smmgen.com/signup](https://my.smmgen.com/signup) if you do not have one

Log in to your dashboard

Navigate to the API section in your account settings

Copy your unique API key

Keep your API key private. Do not include it in public code repositories or client-facing interfaces. Anyone with your API key can place orders against your account balance.

cards.title: Connecting the SMMGen API to Your Panel
cards.body:
Most white label panel software supports SMMGen's API format out of the box. PerfectPanel, BoostPanel, and most common SMM scripts use the same standard endpoint and parameter structure that SMMGen supports.

Log in to your panel admin dashboard

Navigate to the provider or API settings section

Enter the SMMGen API endpoint URL

Paste your SMMGen API key

Run a service sync to import the full catalog

Set your markup on each service category

Save and test with a small order

Most setups complete in under 30 minutes. If you encounter any issues during integration, contact our team at [smmgen.com/contact-us](/contact-us). Our support team assists with API connection queries around the clock.

cards.body:
Places a new order. Returns an order ID.

cards.title: Order Status Labels
cards.body:
When you call the status action, the response includes one of the following status labels:

Pending

Order received, queued for processing

In progress

Delivery is actively running

Completed

Order delivered in full

Partial

Order partially delivered, remainder refunded

Cancelled

Order cancelled before delivery began

layout.heading: API Best Practices for **Resellers**
layout.intro: Field-tested rules for keeping your integration reliable and secure at scale.

cards.title: Test with small orders first
cards.body: Before routing live client orders through the API, place a few small test orders and verify the status responses are coming back correctly.

cards.title: Sync the service catalog regularly
cards.body: Use the services action daily to keep your panel's catalog accurate. SMMGen updates pricing and adds new services regularly.

cards.title: Store order IDs
cards.body: Every order placed via the API returns a unique order ID. Store this in your database so you can check status and handle refunds or cancellations efficiently.

cards.title: Handle partial completions
cards.body: Some orders deliver partially due to the target account being private or the post being deleted. Your system should handle partial status responses and process refunds accordingly.

cards.title: Use HTTPS on your side
cards.body: All API calls to SMMGen use HTTPS. Ensure your own server also uses HTTPS to protect the API key and order data in transit.

cards.title: Do not expose your API key publicly
cards.body: Store your key in environment variables or a secure configuration file. Never commit it to a public code repository.

layout.heading: Frequently Asked Questions About **the SMMGen API**

faq.question: What is an SMM panel API?
faq.answer: An SMM panel API is a programmatic interface that connects your system directly to an SMM provider's service catalog. Instead of placing orders through a dashboard manually, your code sends HTTP requests to the API endpoint. The API processes orders, returns status updates, and provides balance and catalog data in real time. SMMGen's API uses standard HTTP POST requests and returns JSON responses.

faq.question: How do I get a SMMGen API key?
faq.answer: Create a free account at smmgen.com/signup. After logging in, navigate to the API section in your account settings. Your unique API key is displayed there. Copy and store it securely. The API key is free and included with every SMMGen account at no additional cost.

faq.question: Can I automate all orders through the API?
faq.answer: Yes. Every service available in the SMMGen catalog can be ordered through the API. You can also check order status, cancel eligible orders, query your account balance, and retrieve the full service list programmatically. There is no function available in the dashboard that is not also available through the API.

faq.question: What format does the SMMGen API use?
faq.answer: The SMMGen API accepts HTTP POST requests and returns JSON responses. This is the standard format used across the SMM panel industry, making SMMGen compatible with PerfectPanel, BoostPanel, and most common SMM panel scripts without custom modification.

faq.question: Is the API free to use?
faq.answer: Yes. API access is included with every SMMGen account at no additional charge. You only pay for the services you order. There are no API call fees, no monthly access fees, and no setup costs.

faq.question: Can I connect multiple systems to the same API key?
faq.answer: Yes. Your API key works across multiple systems simultaneously. Agencies connecting both a white label panel and a custom internal tool can use the same key. Monitor your balance and order logs from the dashboard to track usage across all connected systems.
